clues.it: Olga era nella 1ª riga e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Olga was in the 1st row and west of Ugo.

clues.it: Giada era nella 4ª colonna e accanto a una sedia a dondolo o a una slitta.
clues.en: Giada was in the 4th column and beside a rocking chair or a sleigh.

clues.it: Anna era l'unica persona su delle caramelle e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Anna was the only person on candy canes and west of Marta.

clues.it: Vito era accanto a un albero di Natale e in una stanza diversa da Anna.
clues.en: Vito was beside a Christmas tree and in a different room from Anna.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th column, in the 5th row and north of Ugo.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era esattamente una riga a nord di Ugo e nella Stalla delle Renne.
clues.en: Rosa was exactly one row north of Ugo and in the Reindeer Stable.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 8ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 8th column, in the 8th row and west of Vito.

clues.it: Marta era nella 9ª riga e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Marta was in the 9th row and west of Vito.

clues.it: Luca era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un albero di Natale, ma non era accanto a una sedia a dondolo.
clues.en: Luca was in the 7th column and beside a Christmas tree, but was not beside a rocking chair.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 2 accanto a un albero di Natale.

steps.it: Solo Olga può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Olga is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Anna's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 3rd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Solo Vito può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 10ª è sua.
steps.en: Vito is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 10th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Fabio può stare nella 6ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Rosa is the only one who can be in the 7th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 8th.

steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 9th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.

steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 7th.
